annotations.text:
The two paper forms, rebuilt.

Every result starts blank — nothing is pre-ticked and no measurement is pre-filled. Click a box to set it, click it again to clear it back to Not Inspected.

Colour is never the only signal: a selected box shows its letter (O / F / I / N), so the form survives a black-and-white print.

The screens around them.

Hub tabs and the two toggle filters really filter the rows; the dropdown filters are drawn only. The pre-inspection is phone width, shown full length — on a device it scrolls under the sticky action bar.
